easyPrerequisites: You control a Warrior that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare a Warrior you control as an attacker, triggering Najeela, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
When the Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
